metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.query:
let Auth0LoginParser = (
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
)
{
let EventLookup = datatable( EventOriginalType: string, EventType: string, EventResult: string, EventOriginalResultDetails: string, EventResultDetails: string)
    [
    //Login
    "f","Logon","Failure","Failed Login","No such user or password",
    "fcoa","Logon","Failure","Failed Cross-Origin Authentication","Other",
    "fens","Logon","Failure","Failed exchange for Native Social Login","Other",
    "fp","Logon","Failure","Failed login due to invalid password","Incorrect password",
    "fu","Logon","Failure","Failed login due to invalid username","No such user",
    "s","Logon","Success","Successful Login","Other",
    "scoa","Logon","Success","Successful Cross-Origin Authentication","Other",
    "sdel","Logon","Success","Successful Delegated Login","Other",
    "sens","Logon","Success","Successful Exchange - Native Social Login","Other",
    //Logout
    "federated_logout_failed","Logoff","Failure","Failed to logout of the upstream Identity Provider","Other",
    "flo","Logoff","Failure","Failed Logout","Other",
    "oidc_backchannel_logout_failed","Logoff","Failure","Failed OIDC Back-Channel Logout request","Other",
    "universal_logout_failed","Logoff","Failure","Failed Universal Logout request","Other",
    "oidc_backchannel_logout_succeeded","Logoff","Success","Successful OIDC Back-Channel Logout request","Other",
    "slo","Logoff","Success","Successful Logout","Other",
    "universal_logout_succeeded","Logoff","Success","Successful Universal Logout request","Other",
    //Silent Authentication
    "fdelsa","Logon","Failure","Failed Delegated Silent Authentication","Session expired",
    "fsa","Logon","Failure","Failed Silent Auth","Session expired",
    "sdelsa","Logon","Success","Successful Delegated Silent Authentication","Other",
    "ssa","Logon","Success","Successful Silent Auth","Other",
    //Token Exchange - Success Events
    "ciba_exchange_succeeded", "Logon", "Success", "Successful CIBA Exchange","Other",
    "feta", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed token exchange at Token Vault","Other",
    "idjag_exchange_succeeded", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Identity Assertion Authorization Grant JWT for Access Token","Other",
    "sdeleacft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Delegated Authorization Code for Access Token","Other",
    "seacft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Authorization Code for Access Token","Other",
    "seccft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Access Token for a Client Credentials Grant","Other",
    "secte", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange via Custom Token Exchange","Other",
    "sede",  "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Device Code for Access Token","Other",
    "seoobft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Password and OOB Challenge for Access Token","Other",
    "seotpft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Password and OTP Challenge for Access Token","Other",
    "sepft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Password for Access Token","Other",
    "sepkoobft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Passkey and OOB Challenge for Access Token","Other",
    "sepkotpft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Passkey and OTP Challenge for Access Token","Other",
    "sepkrcft","Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Passkey and MFA Recovery Code for Access Token","Other",
    "sercft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Password and MFA Recovery Codeode for Access Token","Other",
    "sertft", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange of Refresh Token for Access Token","Other",
    "seta", "Logon", "Success", "Successful token exchange at Token Vault","Other",
    "success_on_behalf_of_token_exchange", "Logon", "Success", "Successful Exchange via On-Behalf-Of Token Exchange","Other",
    //Token Exchange - Failure Events
    "ciba_exchange_failed", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed CIBA Exchange","Other",
    "failed_on_behalf_of_token_exchange", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed Exchange via On-Behalf-Of Token Exchange","Other",
    "fdeleacft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed to Exchange Delegated Authorization Code for Access Token","Other",
    "feacft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed to Exchange Authorization Code for Access Token","Other",
    "feccft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed exchange of Access Token for a Client Credentials Grant","Incorrect key",
    "fecte", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed Exchange via Custom Token Exchange","Other",
    "fede", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed to exchange Device Code for Access Token","Other",
    "feoobft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed exchange of Password and OOB Challenge for Access Token","Incorrect password",
    "feotpft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed exchange of Password and OTP Challenge for Access Token","Incorrect password",
    "fepft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed exchange of Password for Access Token","Incorrect password",
    "fepotpft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed exchange of Passwordless OTP for Access Token","Other",
    "fercft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed Exchange of Password and MFA Recovery Code for Access Token","Incorrect password",
    "ferrt", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed Exchange of Rotating Refresh Token. This could occur when reuse is detected.","Logon violates policy",
    "fertft", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed Exchange of Refresh Token for Access Token. This could occur if the refresh token is revoked or expired.","Session expired",
    "idjag_exchange_failed", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed Exchange of Identity Assertion Authorization Grant JWT for Access Token","Other",
    "jwt_bearer_exchange_failed", "Logon", "Failure", "Failed Exchange of JWT Bearer Assertion for Access Token","Incorrect key",
    //Other events
    "gd_auth_failed", "Logon", "Failure", "Multi-factor authentication failed. This could happen due to a wrong code entered for SMS/Voice/Email/TOTP factors, or a system failure.","Incorrect key",
    "gd_auth_rejected", "Logon", "Failure", "User rejected a multi-factor authentication request via push-notification","Logon violates policy",
    "gd_auth_succeed", "Logon", "Success", "Multi-factor authentication success.","Other",
    "gd_recovery_failed", "Logon", "Failure", "A user entered a wrong Recovery Code when attempting to authenticate","Incorrect key",
    "gd_recovery_succeed", "Logon", "Success", "Multi-factor recovery code succeeded authorization","Other",
    "gd_webauthn_challenge_failed", "Logon", "Failure", "WebAuthn browser failure","Incorrect key",
    "passkey_challenge_failed", "Logon", "Failure", "A native passkey challenge failed","Incorrect key"
    ];
let AuthEvents = toscalar(
    EventLookup
    | summarize make_set(EventOriginalType)
);
Auth0Logs_CL
| where not(disabled)
| project-rename EventOriginalType = EventType
| where EventOriginalType in~ (AuthEvents)
| lookup EventLookup on EventOriginalType 
| extend 
    EventProduct = "Auth0"
    , TargetAppName = ClientName
    , Src = SrcHostname
    , SrcGeoCountry = tostring(LocationInfo.country_name)
    , SrcGeoCity = tostring(LocationInfo.city_name)
    , SrcGeoLongitude = toreal(LocationInfo.longitude)
    , SrcGeoLatitude = toreal(LocationInfo.latitude)
    , TargetSessionId = tostring(Details.session_id)
    , TransactionId = tostring(Details.transaction_id)
    , RedirectUri = tostring(Details.qs.redirect_uri)
    , Actions = tostring(Details.actions)
    , Prompt = tostring(Details.prompts)
    , LoginStats = tostring(Details.stats)
| extend TargetUsernameType =
    case ( 
        ActorUsername contains "@" , "UPN"
        , ActorUsername contains "\\", "Windows"
        , (ActorUsername has "CN=" or ActorUsername has "OU=" or ActorUsername has "DC="), "DN"
        , isempty(ActorUsername), ""
        , "Simple"
    )
| extend TargetUsername =
    case (
        ActorUsername contains "@" , tostring(split(ActorUsername,"@")[0])
        , ActorUsername contains "\\", tostring(split(ActorUsername,"\\")[0])
        , ActorUsername
    )
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(
    pack == true,
    bag_pack(
        "Connection", Connection,
        "ConnectionId", ConnectionId,
        "Audience", Audience,
        "Scope", Scope,
        "Strategy", Strategy,
        "StrategyType", StrategyType,
        "Actions", Actions,
        "Prompt", Prompt,
        "RedirectUri", RedirectUri,
        "LoginStats", LoginStats,
        "TransactionId", TransactionId,
        "Details",Details,
        "TenantName",TenantName,
        "IsMobile", IsMobile,
        "TenantId", TenantId,
        "_ResourceId",_ResourceId
    ),
    dynamic({})
)
| project
      //madatory fields
      TimeGenerated
      , EventCount = int(1)
      , EventStartTime = iff(isempty(event_date),TimeGenerated, event_date)
      , EventEndTime = iff(isempty(event_date),TimeGenerated, event_date)
      , EventType 
      , EventResult
      , EventProduct
      , EventVendor = "Okta"
      , EventSchema = "Authentication"
      , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
      , Type
      //recommended
      , EventResultDetails
      , EventOriginalResultDetails
      , EventUid = _ItemId
      //optional
      , UserId = tostring(ActorUserId)
      , TargetUsername
      , TargetUsernameType
      , EventMessage = Description
      , EventOriginalUid = LogId
      , EventOriginalType
      , AdditionalFields
      //other fields
      , TargetSessionId
      , TargetAppId = ClientId
      , TargetAppName
      , TargetAppType = "Other"
      , Src
      , SrcIpAddr
      , SrcGeoCountry
      , SrcGeoCity
      , SrcGeoLongitude
      , SrcGeoLatitude
      , HttpUserAgent
      // aliases
      , User = TargetUsername
      , IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
      , Application = TargetAppName
      , Dvc = EventProduct
};
Auth0LoginParser(
    disabled = disabled,
    pack = pack
)
